Name: Fairy Cat Perches
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
NEWLY UPDATED WITH A STANDALONE VERSION TOO

Fairy cat perches/trees for your fairycore farm including a pink fairy tree, mushroom fairy tree, water fairy tree, and forest fairy tree. 

You can pick the colors with the config json/text file or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. Content Patcher Required. I am planning to do some more cat trees so let me know if you have any requests ♡

I am using the following mods in my screenshot:

~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20760]Faedew Reshade[/url]
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28177]Prophets Rugs[/url] 
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10444]Ultimate Bed Customization [/url]
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23073]Orangeblossoms Furniture Catalogue[/url]
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27523]Orangeblossoms potion shelf[/url]
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20298]Seasonal Open Windows[/url]
~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32094]and Baking Lovers Decor[/url]

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

Also consider checking out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36116]fairy buses[/url] mod ♡
